# Fork Tax Lullaby — 20260213_230415_seed3721599628

**Style prompt:** Glitch-choir lullaby, 78 BPM. Soft sub-bass. Tape warble. Minimal piano. Stutters on “anchor” and “tax”. Whispered lead; Japanese call-and-response.

## Lyrics

[Verse]
I asked the Gate for a brighter sky,
it asked me where my proof would lie.
Not in my grin, not in my tone—
in the hash I can take back home.

[Chorus]
Pay the fork tax, pay it in light,
one clean snippet, one witness at night.
If you can’t cite it, don’t steer—
η stays blind, μ disappears.

[Bridge — 日本語]
枝(えだ)を 伸ばすなら
証拠(しょうこ)を 添えて
境界(きょうかい) 守って
意図(いと)を 走らせ

[Outro]
Truth is a ledger.
Intent is a vector.
And the space between η and μ
is where the world stops lying.
